knob: chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort, read by the chat template's first lines: 'low' and 'high' render as such, anything else (or nothing) renders Max. The Chat route passes a request's chat_template_kwargs to the template; it never passes the top-level reasoning_effort (no GLM serving extension).

levels.off: not offered: GLM-5.3 always thinks; pi clamps off to minimal
levels.max: Reasoning Effort: Max (the model card's evaluation setting)

notes: Only for templates that read reasoning_effort with the levels low/high/max (GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash). GLM-5.2's template knows only 'high' (low would render Max), and a template that does not read reasoning_effort makes trtllm-serve's unused-kwargs guard answer 400.
